tldr: Sharp REBOUND: the day after the hawkish-hold selloff, US stocks snapped back — Nasdaq +2.8% (best day of the year), S&P +1.7% to a record 7,437.63, Dow +1.2% — led by Microsoft's record one-day value gain and a semis recovery.

AI-capex re-validated: Amazon +9% AH on AWS +37% to $42.2bn (fastest in 18 quarters) and a raised ~$220bn 2026 capex plan; Apple beat on revenue (+16.6%, iPhone +22%) but -4% AH on a Services miss — the acute chip-leg bear case (SMIC) eased.

'Stagflation-lite' keeps the Fed hawkish: Q2 GDP slowed to +1.5% while June core PCE stuck at +3.3% y/y — validating the three FOMC hike dissents; 10Y ~4.68%, 2Y at fresh 2026 highs. September is still a live hike risk for levered silver + SGX REITs.
The book's core firmed anyway: gold pushed to ~$4,080 near a record on the sticky-inflation/haven bid, silver held ~$57, crypto recovered (BTC ~$64.8k) — supportive relative signals.
Oil stays elevated: the US-Iran pause remained BROKEN — Brent held >$92 (WTI ~$84) on renewed US strikes and Hormuz shipping attacks; the war/inflation premium is re-armed, GDX the cleaner hedge.

Record-high tape + sticky inflation + a live September hike = little cushion. Don't chase the record; keep the ~3.5-3.75% USD cash pile as dry powder into next week's SGX/HK earnings and the 31 Jul Flow Show.
